capabilities.summary: Supervised vendor agent sessions for Right Suite apps: shared agent event model, Claude Code stream-json and Codex app-server protocol clients, session lifecycle with approvals and tree teardown, recorded fixtures. No SDK, no HTTP, no MCP.
policyNotes: Declaration-only: vendor CLI protocol handling is not a dependency fingerprint.
0.2.0 adds the session lifecycle (feature session) over rightkit-child-process; the API backend lands in a later release.
